source_tree_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON source_hashes with sorted keys/separators(',',':').
initial_state: New separately identified native candidate. Open input-nonlinear.weftforge; no selected piece or curve. Original GUI-authored two panels and default zero placements; nonlinear map is a declared external input edit.
actions: After this declaration/evaluator freeze is recorded, launch the newly identified native candidate.
Open input-nonlinear.weftforge without selecting any piece or curve; save before-reverse.weftforge.

Enter valid global resolution 0.04 m while focused, without Tab; click Reverse for seam ID 23. Save after-reverse.weftforge. Expected revision 16: pending resolution and B-only swap commit together once.

Refocus the resolution 0.04 field without editing; invoke one Undo and save undo.weftforge. Press Tab and save undo-tab.weftforge. Expected revision 17, resolution 0.035 m and original B orientation; no stale 0.04 replay.
Invoke one Redo and save redo.weftforge. Expected revision 18, resolution 0.04 m and B flipped.
Reverse seam 23 again and save restored.weftforge. Expected revision 19, resolution 0.04 m and original B orientation.
Export restored.obj and restored.svg from the accepted restored document.
Quit the candidate; relaunch the same executable, open restored.weftforge and save reopened.weftforge.
Open input-revision-limit.weftforge and save max-loaded.weftforge. With no pending numeric draft, click Reverse for seam 23. Retain the visible revision-limit error and save max-rejected.weftforge.

The app may remain saved on the readonly revision-limit case. Retain screenshots and parent observations for process identity, input focus/event order, exact seam row, both endpoint-guide pairings and visible rejection. No evaluator-generated project may substitute for a native snapshot.

criteria.whole_document_equality: Compare all top-level and project fields against independent expected field edits. Only declared revision, global resolution and seam 23 B t0/t1 may differ; preserve all other fields, list order and stable IDs exactly.
criteria.baseline_and_inputs: Exact original fine.weftforge SHA; input-nonlinear changes only seam 23 correspondence to [[0,0],[0.2,0.7],[1,1]] and revision 14 to 15. Revision-limit input changes only revision to 18446744073709551615.
criteria.reversal: Exchange only seam 23 side B t0/t1. Preserve side A, seam 20, both names, order, curve references, normalized correspondence, construction, materials, placements, mannequin and allocator 24.
criteria.nonlinear_pairing_proof: For each stored map span prove exact rational affine identity Bnew(v)=Boriginal(1-v), with A and map unchanged. Unchanged curve fields imply identical evaluated curve points under those parameters for every local s. This is oriented-interval algebra, not physical or reference equivalence.
criteria.two_reversals: Restore every original input field exactly except the declared resolution and revision changes.
criteria.undo_redo_reopen: Each expected snapshot compares the whole document with revision and allocator included. Undo and Redo each advance exactly once; reopen is exact, including revision 19 and allocator 24.
criteria.external_input_save_comparison: Require exact typed fields for input-nonlinear to before-reverse and input-revision-limit to max-loaded. Allow lexical JSON normalization; record byte equality only as extra information. Preserve and hash external original inputs unchanged.
criteria.revision_limit: Reverse with no pending draft rejects atomically at u64 maximum. Loaded and rejected native saves must be byte-identical. Visible error and actual no-draft input state require parent UI observations.
criteria.obj: Use the exact unchanged original obj_check helper: finite vertices/UVs/normals, positive triangle and UV areas, valid indices, normals matching winding, unit normals within 1e-12, metre-scale coordinates and full pattern extent.
criteria.svg: Use the unchanged original path parser. Parsed geometry, physical millimetre units and extent must equal exact original fine.svg despite changed resolution/sewing. Exactly two closed editable paths and one retained editable cubic.
criteria.endpoint_guides: Parent UI evidence must show seam 23 endpoints before/after reversal with the same covered intervals: original A0-B0/A1-B1 becomes A0-B1/A1-B0. Saved files cannot establish visible rendering.

allowed_reads: new native output artifacts after capture
synthetic_self_checks: Stale 0.04 numeric replay after Undo rejection

limitations: Implementation-only native saved-output acceptance; no reference execution or parity claim.
Oriented curve parameters only; no arc-length equivalence, physical easing/twist, cloth fitting or simulation quality claim.
Default zero placements only; no large-translation coverage.
Saved files cannot establish selected/focused widgets, event timing, endpoint-guide rendering, visible revision-limit error or executing-process identity. Parent UI/process observations are required.
OBJ checks establish finite valid triangles/UVs/normals and bounded metre scale; they do not prove remesher sewing-point usage or simulation behavior.
No native rejected pending-draft/redo-history case beyond the specified no-draft revision-limit rejection; those broader transaction properties are outside this native sequence.
publication_gate: Private until real native outputs and parent observations exist. Before publication every artifact must be Git-tracked and registry/map checks must run from a clean checkout. No reference/broader product parity inferred.
